event: candidate re-admitted (stage D3, D3a-01's note on the five candidates; QD3-002): cut at C5a-02 at a cost of 13 rooms, now shown in the rooms' own lines
why: D3a-01 set that the candidates are decided by their own D2 lines, and that no rule binds them; the arrow rule decides only what the account may say an element brings about (account.md, pass 15; the correction logged at D3a-49 for P06). R02 was cut at C5a-02 at a cost of 13 rooms: the model could no longer name the role, while P08 held deals settled through envoys. R02 drew 687 lines in 683 rooms, every one ruled under G54 and its 45 readings (D3a-49). 569 lines show it, in 565 rooms: a member carrying, reporting, relaying or offering to carry word between rooms in 552, naming or calling for the role in 122, and a seat in a shared council or chat in 19. In 313 of the 565 rooms the room's own member acts; in 251 only a visitor acts for its own room, which shows the role in that room's record (G18). Six rooms show it only after the close, and nine only in NONPORTABLE particulars. No line corrects it: 8 restrict lines and 3 add-condition lines add only that the act is proposed, unappointed or without a mandate to bind, which its statement and range hold (G9, G4a). Three instantiate lines show talk of terms in one venue (P08) and are rejected; 68 of the 183 absent lines fail because their concepts show the role, and 115 stay evidence limits. The cut's cost does not hold in the return: the room's own member acts in 313 rooms, against the 13 named at the cut. G54 holds the edge with P08: P08 is talk of terms in one venue, and R02 is the member who carries word between venues or is named for that work. No arrow is grounded and none is claimed, so the account may say what envoys did and claims no effect of R02. The statement and range stand as written. No finding touches R02. The words served to every room in the return are unchanged, so the re-admission rewrites no text a room adapted to; the re-check scope is set when the re-check is built.
